purpose: Editorial concept illustration, explicitly labeled AI-generated. Not a handmade original or portfolio case.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a premium editorial illustration for CookDance's English journal article about human touch and hand-drawn illustration in the age of AI. Create one landscape 3:2 artwork, not a photograph and not a mockup of a studio. Scene: two simply and elegantly drawn adult hands, one entering diagonally from upper left and one from lower right, gently sharing a small handmade ceramic tea cup across a quiet table. A single lemon and a small olive twig rest nearby. The cup and hands form a compact central composition, so a portrait crop from the middle still communicates the act of care. Style: expressive gouache and colored pencil on warm uncoated ivory paper; visible dry-brush edges, uneven charcoal outlines, translucent pigment, a few searching pencil marks and deliberately unpainted space. Restrained adult independent-magazine art direction, tender but not cute, human-scale and tactile. Palette: deep olive green, muted terracotta, soft ochre, cream, and natural skin tones. Keep the composition simple and the paper texture credible. The two hands should each have natural plausible anatomy without excessive detail. No text, lettering, logos, robot, computer, futuristic motifs, glossy 3D, vector-flat finish, border, watermark or claims of a real handmade original. This is explicitly an AI-generated concept illustration and will be labeled as such; it should illustrate the editorial idea without pretending to document real commissioned work.
